blocks.en: In applications, it typically depends on boundary conditions whether expansion in a cosine or sine series is desirable; see the examples in Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction} and also the comments below on pointwise convergence of Fourier series. The expansion in terms of sines and cosines provided by Corollary~\ref{cor:fourier-complex-hilbert-basis} is typically used for periodic functions.
blocks.zh: 在应用中, 宜用余弦级数还是正弦级数展开, 通常取决于边界条件; 见 Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction} 中的例子, 以及以下关于 Fourier 级数逐点收敛的说明. Corollary~\ref{cor:fourier-complex-hilbert-basis} 提供的正弦与余弦展开通常用于周期函数.

blocks.en: It is known from measure theory that a sequence converging in $L^2$ has a subsequence which converges almost everywhere. For Fourier series it is actually not necessary to take a subsequence; this is a hard theorem which was not proved until 1966. A much more elementary observation is that $\sum_{n=0}^\infty a_n\cos(n\pi x)$ converges uniformly on $[0,1]$ if $\sum_{n=0}^\infty|a_n|$ converges, and using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality in $\ell^2$, we can see that this is the case if $\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n|^2n^\alpha$ converges for any $\alpha>1$ (set $|a_n|=(|a_n|n^{\alpha/2})(n^{-\alpha/2})$; if $\alpha>1$, then the sequence $n^{-\alpha/2}$ is in $\ell^2$).
blocks.zh: 由测度论知道, 在 $L^2$ 中收敛的序列具有几乎处处收敛的子列. 对 Fourier 级数, 实际上不必取子列; 这是直到 1966 年才被证明的一个困难定理. 一个初等得多的观察是, 若 $\sum_{n=0}^\infty|a_n|$ 收敛, 则 $\sum_{n=0}^\infty a_n\cos(n\pi x)$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上一致收敛; 利用 $\ell^2$ 中的 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式可知, 若对任意 $\alpha>1$ 有 $\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n|^2n^\alpha$ 收敛, 就属于这一情形 (令 $|a_n|=(|a_n|n^{\alpha/2})(n^{-\alpha/2})$; 若 $\alpha>1$, 则序列 $n^{-\alpha/2}$ 属于 $\ell^2$).

blocks.en: The first of these expressions represents a cosine series for $f$, and since \[\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n^2|<\infty\] we have \[\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n|/n\pi<\infty,\] i.e., the first series in \eqref{eq:fourier-antiderivative-cosine-sine-expansions} converges uniformly. Hence any $f\in L^2(0,1)$ which has a derivative in $L^2(0,1)$ has a uniformly convergent cosine series. (In particular, this implies that any such $f$ is continuous. This is a special case of the Sobolev embedding theorem.) Moreover, in the sense of $L^2$-convergence, the series can be differentiated term by term.
blocks.zh: 这些表达式中的第一个表示 $f$ 的余弦级数, 且由于 \[\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n^2|<\infty\] 有 \[\sum_{n=1}^\infty|a_n|/n\pi<\infty,\] 即 \eqref{eq:fourier-antiderivative-cosine-sine-expansions} 中的第一个级数一致收敛. 因而, 任何具有 $L^2(0,1)$ 中导数的 $f\in L^2(0,1)$ 都具有一致收敛的余弦级数. (特别地, 这意味着任何这样的 $f$ 都连续. 这是 Sobolev 嵌入定理的一个特例.) 此外, 在 $L^2$ 收敛意义下, 该级数可以逐项求导.

blocks.en: The second series in \eqref{eq:fourier-antiderivative-cosine-sine-expansions}, on the other hand, is a sine series only if $\beta=b_0=0$. It is easy to see that $\beta=f(0)$ and $b_0=\int_0^1 f'(x)\,\mathrm{d}x=f(1)$. Hence any function $f\in L^2(0,1)$ such that $f'\in L^2(0,1)$ and in addition $f(0)=f(1)=0$ has an absolutely convergent sine series. This shows that the convergence behavior of a Fourier series is influenced not only by the smoothness of the function but also by its behavior at the boundary.
blocks.zh: 另一方面, \eqref{eq:fourier-antiderivative-cosine-sine-expansions} 中的第二个级数只有在 $\beta=b_0=0$ 时才是正弦级数. 容易看出 $\beta=f(0)$ 且 $b_0=\int_0^1 f'(x)\,\mathrm{d}x=f(1)$. 因而, 任何满足 $f'\in L^2(0,1)$ 且另有 $f(0)=f(1)=0$ 的函数 $f\in L^2(0,1)$ 都具有绝对收敛的正弦级数. 这表明 Fourier 级数的收敛行为不仅受函数光滑性的影响, 还受其边界行为的影响.
